rank2_policy.search_claim: finite four-point explicit composition screen; not exhaustive measure

protocol.timing: CUDA-event kernel time; compile, plan creation and initialization are outside kernel timing
protocol.correctness: full-batch verification is required; verify-batches=0 means the benchmark checks every batch

omitted_candidate_families.reason: Current standalone compiler limits factor_ept to 32; N24 native factors would require EPT=64 under the existing uniform-factor request contract.

candidate_policy.runtime_export: deferred; the bounded manifest is not a substitute for target-GPU --list-design-points

limitations: This is a separate exploratory extension and must not be merged into the existing E1 mean.
The screen denominator is exactly 16 candidates: 12 searched candidates plus 4 mapping seeds; seeds are candidates, not extra budget.
The 1D acceptance schema represents batch independent transforms, not rank-2 or rank-3 dimensions.
Rank 2 is API-supported but has no matching run_research_acceptance adapter in this queue; its two supplementary shapes use four fixed explicit compositions each with full cuFFT output verification.
Rank 3 is rejected by cubutterflySetShape and is outside this extension.
Historical exclusion records are kept out of the new GPU1 journal even when their old verification or build identity is incomplete.
The limited module manifest is structural preparation; target-GPU legality, correctness and runtime candidate coverage remain pending.
Acceptance requires a fresh independent GPU1 stage calibration checkpoint; the historical target stage checkpoint is never imported.
The historical mapping registry is used only as four candidate seeds and does not contribute historical timing to the new mean.
The rank-2 screen is exactly four explicit composition variants per shape; it is not an exhaustive measure search.
